CHAPTER 1 GENERAL REGULATIONS

8-1-2: PURPOSE:
   A.   This Chapter establishes the zoning regulations for Ada County, Idaho. This Title:
      1.   Fulfills the intent and purposes of the "Local Land Use Planning Act," Idaho Code Section 67-6501 et seq., as amended.
      2.   Implements the policies of the applicable Comprehensive Plans by classifying and regulating the uses of property and structures within the unincorporated areas of Ada County.
      3.   Establishes zoning districts within Ada County that comply with the adopted Comprehensive Plans in conformance with Idaho Code Section 67-6511.
      4.   Provides standards for the orderly growth and development of Ada County. As required by Idaho Code Section 67-6511, these standards include those regulating:
         a.   The height, number of stories, size, construction, reconstruction, alteration, repair, or location of structures;
         b.   Percentage of coverage, size of required yards, and density of residential dwellings; and
         c.   The use of structures and property.
   B.   Ensures appropriate use of properties.
   C.   Preservation of Private Property Rights:
      1.   This title shall be interpreted to equally protect citizens from the undue encroachment on their private property by their neighbor's use of their private property and equally protect each citizen's right to use of their property without creating undue burden upon their neighbors.
      2.   In the administration of this title, every person shall be secure in their premises, and no employee of the county shall enter upon, investigate, or search any of the premises of any citizen without the consent of such citizen or order issued by a court of proper jurisdiction.
      3.   Every citizen of Ada County shall have the right to appear in person or be represented by his or her agent before the board in the proper order of business to appeal a decision pursuant to the procedures contained in Section 8-6-13 of this Title.
      4.   In the enforcement of this Title, it shall be deemed to apply to each citizen and each property in similar circumstances and shall not be enforced to discriminate between one individual and/or another individual or other group as compared to all others.
   D.   Provides a method of administration and prescribes penalties for the violations of regulations authorized by the Constitution and laws of the State of Idaho.
(Ord. 1002, 10-28-2025)
8-1-3: SCOPE:
   A.   This Title consists of the most recently adopted and amended zoning text, official zoning maps, and subdivision regulations. Copies are available for review at the Ada County Development Services Department. This Title and all its terms are to be read and interpreted with consideration to the designations of the official zoning maps (see Section 8-2-4).
   B.   This Title applies to any of the following in the unincorporated areas of Ada County:
      1.   The height, number of stories, size, construction, reconstruction, alteration, repair or use of buildings and structures;
      2.   The percentage of lot occupancy, size of courts, yards, and open spaces;
      3.   The density of population;
      4.   The location and use of buildings and structures;
      5.   Any subdivision; and
      6.   Standards for building or development.
(Ord. 1002, 10-28-2025)
8-1-4: AUTHORITY:
   A.   This Title is adopted pursuant to:
      1.   Article 12, Section 2 of the Idaho Constitution (local police regulations).
      2.   Idaho Code Title 67, Chapter 65 (Local Land Use Planning Act).
      3.   Idaho Code Title 50, Chapter 13 (Plats and Vacations).
(Ord. 1002, 10-28-2025)
8-1-5: APPLICABILITY:
   A.   Compliance And Approval Required: No person or public agency shall construct, alter, move, or change the use of a structure or undertake any development or changes to the property unless:
      1.   Such action complies with this Title.
      2.   Any required approval is obtained as provided by Chapter 6 of this Title and any applicable conditions of approval are met.
   B.   Permits Required: Nothing in this Title eliminates the need to obtain any other required permits, including:
      1.   Building permits, plumbing, electrical, or mechanical permits: or
      2.   Any permit or entitlement required by other titles of the County Code, other political subdivisions of the state of Idaho, or agencies of the state of Idaho.
   C.   Unincorporated County Properties: All properties in unincorporated Ada County shall comply with this Title unless otherwise preempted by federal statute, state law, or local ordinance.
   D.   Previous Violations: The violations that occurred under previous land use regulations and that remain a violation under this Title will continue until resolved.
   E.   Project With Pending Application: All applications shall be processed and reviewed according to the ordinances and comprehensive plans in effect when the application is submitted.
   F.   Approved Projects Not Yet Completed: Any approved application may be completed as provided by the approval.
(Ord. 1002, 10-28-2025)
8-1-6: CONFLICTING PROVISIONS:
   A.   If there is conflict between the text and the maps of this Title, the maps prevail.
   B.   If conflicts occur between different regulations of this Title, or between this Title and other regulations of County Code, the most restrictive regulation applies. If there is a conflict between the Idaho Code and the County Code, the Idaho Code shall prevail.
   C.   It is not intended that this Title interfere with, abrogate, or annul any easements, covenants, or other agreements between parties. However, where this Title imposes a greater restriction upon the use of structures or premises or upon the height of structures or requires larger space than is imposed or required by ordinances, rules, or regulations, or by easements, covenants, or agreements, the regulations of this Title govern.
(Ord. 1002, 10-28-2025)
8-1-7: MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:
   When interpreting and applying the regulations of this Title, all regulations are minimum requirements, unless stated otherwise. Proposed uses shall comply with all applicable regulations and standards unless specifically exempt elsewhere in this Title.
(Ord. 1002, 10-28-2025)
8-1-8: ENACTMENT, EFFECTIVE DATE, AND REPEAL:
   Upon the date of publication of this Title, this Title repeals and replaces all previous zoning ordinances.
(Ord. 1002, 10-28-2025)
8-1-9: SEVERABILITY AND SAVINGS CLAUSE:
   Should any section, clause, or regulation of this Title be declared by a court of competent jurisdiction to be invalid, the same shall not affect the validity of this Title, or any part thereof, other than the part so declared to be invalid; each section, clause, or regulation hereof being declared severable.
(Ord. 1002, 10-28-2025)
